method: Viewed actual source photograph/PDF raster and all eleven final reimported GLB CPU preview PNGs.
observations: Two-car consist now has separate transforms and observation fronts facing outward; Blender importer quaternion rotation mode was explicitly changed before setting rear-car Euler yaw.
Detailed and intermediate exterior preserve side windows, six paired door openings, wheel/bogie separation and end gangway.
Interior view has continuous open aisle, side-mounted displays, cantilever seats without floor legs, priority colour and clear vestibules.
Open vs closed views show actual independent leaves moved away from the crossing; floor remains in place.
Section view confirms hollow shell and roof/floor separation; this is a QA cut, not a runtime asset.
Reference abstract figure measures1.80m from platform top, below actual2.13m opening.
Gangway is a real opening but moving intercar traversal is disabled.
limits: Representative low-poly box/chamfer-free styling is not exact Rotem reproduction.
LOD2 deliberately shows broad blue closed-door markers; no exact near/far livery continuity claim.
32-sample CPU pictures retain noise; this Blender build has no OpenImageDenoise support.
QA platform shown in boarding-human-scale is not the actual station interface; the station package provides threshold geometry separately.
No WebGL/runtime/ride acceptance, no night lighting implementation.
